args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks following the latest production deploy (v2.3.1, previously unhealthy). Rolling back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production was performed, and v2.3.0 has been rolled out to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Service health is being verified post-rollback. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failure to be investigated by on-call.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what happened:

**Diagnosis:** The latest production release of `checkout-api` (v2.3.1) was unhealthy. The most recent release that had been healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 across all production regions — us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
2. **Verified health** post-rollback: all regions are now on v2.3.0 and reporting healthy, with a 0.2% error rate.
3. **Opened incident INC-0001** (SEV2) describing the failure and the rollback, and it paged the on-call engineer as expected.

The service is now restored to v2.3.0 and healthy in all production regions. The on-call team has the incident for root-cause analysis of the v2.3.1 failure.
